source: NASA CCMC DONKI - https://ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov/DONKI/ (real events, 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31)
setting: Lunar base: only events that reach the Earth-Moon system are included.

fields.dialog: [0] real alert: date, who saw it and a comparison; [1] what to do in the base
fields.explanations: One short analogy per event type. Say it the first time that type appears, between dialog[0] and dialog[1]
fields.radiation_points: Extra radiation added to the environment, 0-100 game scale (see radiation_scale)
fields.blackout: True if the event can knock out the base's power
fields.arrival_minutes: Minutes from the robot's warning until the event hits the base
fields.arrival_source: observed (real DONKI times), forecast (NASA model) or estimate (physics/typical value)
fields.chain: Linked events (e.g. flare -> particle storm -> CME). Play them in 'step' order; null = standalone

radiation_scale.FLR: X-ray peak flux, log scale: M1 = 5, X1 = 10, X10 = 15
radiation_scale.SEP: Highest proton energy measured near Earth: >10 MeV = 25, ~30-50 MeV = 40, >100 MeV = 60

blackout_rules.CME: Direct hit at >= 700 km/s: plasma charges the base and electric discharges can trip the power system
blackout_rules.SEP: Only >100 MeV storms: particles cause electronic faults in the power system
blackout_rules.FLR: No: light does not cut power on the Moon

excluded: GST, RBE and MPC only happen inside Earth's magnetic field; CMEs not aimed at Earth; particles and solar wind measured only by STEREO-A (far from the Moon); C-class flares (negligible).

explanations.FLR: A solar flare is like a giant camera flash on the Sun. Its light reaches the Moon in just 8 minutes! Scientists grade flares C, M and X, and X is the biggest.
explanations.CME: Scientists call this a coronal mass ejection, or CME. It is like the Sun sneezing out a cloud of hot gas much bigger than the Earth. It takes one to four days to reach the Moon.
explanations.SEP: These particles are tiny bits of atoms, faster than anything people have ever built. On Earth, the air and a magnetic shield protect us like an umbrella. The Moon has neither, so our walls are the umbrella!
explanations.IPS: A shock wave is like the wave in front of a fast boat: it arrives first and shakes everything it passes.
explanations.HSS: Some parts of the Sun blow a faster wind, like a fan that is always on. It gives moon dust static, so it sticks to everything, like a balloon rubbed on your hair!
